messages:
elena: Quick sync — for the upcoming docs release (v0.9.3) I want to slim the release notes to a short TL;DR + links and move the long migration steps into a dedicated migration guide. Who can own snippet alignment?
matt: I can take snippet alignment. Found one failing Python snippet in the SDK quickstart, will update to new API. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024
diana: I'll start the migration guide skeleton under /docs/migrate/. Plan: old-vs-new headings + copyable code steps. Any blockers?
samir: Heads-up — known issue: streaming + function-calls can produce a duplicated final token in some runtimes. We should add a Known Issues note and recommended workaround (disable streaming). Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/57
elena: Thanks. matt — when you update snippets, prefer the new SDK pattern: `from redwood import Client` (avoid the old `import redwood` style). Also keep examples minimal (no extra deps).
matt: Will do. I'll update python + ts snippets in one PR. New draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102 — includes snippet fixes + a couple link redirects. Example change in the PR: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.chat.create(model="kestrel-v1", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
```
diana: Migration guide draft path: `/docs/migrate/v0.9-to-v1.0.md`. I'll add step-by-step code blocks and a short checklist (tokenization, batching, config keys). ping @samir for wording on the function-call caveat.
samir: Suggested wording: "If you observe duplicate final tokens when using streaming + function calls, disable streaming or pin runtime to v1.2.3 until the kernel patch lands." Keep it short and include the GH issue link.
elena: :thumbsup: That reads well. For the changelog line, keep it high-level: "Improved batching heuristics and streaming stability" — we'll link to the migration guide for details.
matt: One more note — old snippets under `/sdk/python/old.md` need redirects to `/sdk/python/quickstart`. I'll add link replacements in my PR as well.
docs-bot: FYI — docs CI failed on staging: lint error in the migration file (missing blank line before fenced code block). See: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/ci/9876
diana: On it. Fixing lint and the small wording tweaks now. ETA ~30m. Once CI passes we can merge the migration guide and cut the relnotes draft for docs review.
